INTERVIEW EXPERIENCE
SUMMER INTERNSHIP 2022
Mohak Chandani
Third Year
Information Technology

ROUND 1 - ONLINE TEST (1 HOUR)
Eligibility Criteria : Students from CS, IT, EXTC with 7+ CPI (No Backlogs)
Online Test was conducted on 15th Nov, 2021 at 4:00 PM on HackerRank. The test had
1. 23 MCQs which were based on
●
Java, C++ and a few on Python ( OOPs, Predict the Output )
●
Pseudocode for getting the output
●
DSA (Quicksort, Doubly Linked list)
●
DBMS (Normalization, SQL Queries and SQL keywords eg. DISTINCT)
2. One Coding Question
The coding Question was Matrix Traversal
Given a 4 x 4 matrix mat, the initial energy is 100. The task is to reach the last row of the
matrix with the maximum possible energy left.
The matrix can be traversed in the following way:
1. Start with any cell in the first row.
2. In each move, traverse from cell (i.) of the throw and th column to any existing
cell out of (i + 1, j-1), (i+1, j) or (i+1, j+1).
3. Finish the traversal in the last row.
After stepping on a cell (i, j), energy decreases by mat[i][j] units. Find the maximum
possible energy left at the end of the traversal.
Note: The final energy can be negative.
Example mat =[ [10, 20, 30, 401],
[60, 50, 20, 80],
[10, 10, 10, 10],
[60, 50, 60, 50] ]
Ans : 0 ( 100 - ( 20 + 20 +10 + 50 ) )
I gave a recursive solution (as the size of the matrix was fixed) and all the test cases were
passed. There was an optimized solution using Dynamic Programming.
The question was similar to this.

INTERVIEW 1 - TECHNICAL (30 MINUTES)
Interviews were scheduled on 18th November, 2021. 9 students were shortlisted for the
interviews. My interview was at 10:00 AM on Skype Business Meetings.
There were 2 interviewers and both of them were very friendly. I was asked
●
Tell me about yourself.
●
Tell me about your projects.
Then she started with DBMS.
●
What is Normalization and what is its purpose ?
●
What are various Joins in SQL ?
●
What are DDL and DML ?
●
Difference between DELETE and TRUNCATE ? Can we use WHERE clause in
DELETE and TRUNCATE ?
●
What are the various SQL set operations ? What is UNION ALL operation ?
Then I was asked questions on C++, OOPs and DSA
●
What are Constructors and destructors ?
●
How to allocate and deallocate memory in C++ ?
●
What is Polymorphism and its types ?
●
Difference between Virtual and  Pure Virtual Functions ?
●
What is a Linked list and explain its types ?
SQL Query
●
Get the maximum salary from each department. And then she extended the
question , If I also want to know the id of the employee ?
Then she asked, Did you use any strategy while making these projects ? And then asked
indirectly about stages of SDLC ( Software Development Life Cycle ) ?
Do you wish to ask any questions ? I asked 2.

INTERVIEW 2 - TECHNICAL (30 MINUTES)
The second interview was scheduled on the same day at 2:30 PM on Skype Business
Meetings. This round had more Resume related questions. There were 2 interviewers
and both of them were very friendly.
●
Tell me about yourself and your projects.
●
Which is your preferred language ? I said C++.
●
What are the Pillars of OOPs ?
●
Explain Abstraction with a real life example.
●
What is Multiple inheritance?
●
What are the problems with multiple inheritance ?
As I also mentioned Python, MERN stack and Javascript in my resume I was asked,
●
Do you know ‘join’ function in python ? What is its use ?
Then I was shown a code snippet with a join function and was told to give the output.
●
What is the difference between == and === in Javascript ?
●
What are the advantages of MongoDB ?
●
Why did you use React ?
●
What are React keys ?
●
What is Dynamic Typing ?
●
Do you have any Questions ?
ROUND 3 - HR (TELEPHONIC)
This round was on a phone call at around 5:30 PM. I was asked,
●
What is your branch ?
●
Where do you live ?
●
What are your hobbies ?
●
Why do you want to join UBS ? (Go through the company website. You will get
many points)
The result was declared the same day at 10:00 PM. They selected 7 people and I was
fortunate to be one of them.

TIPS & RESOURCES
1. For Data Structures & Algorithms , I have practiced on 450dsa , Leetcode Top
Questions
2. Referred this for DBMS and this for SQL Queries.
3. Watched Gate Smashers Playlist and read this for Operating Systems. (Although
OS was not asked in any of my interviews still it is asked by some companies)
4. Referred this for OOPs in C++.
5. If you have mentioned C++ and Python on your Resume then you can expect C++
Vs Python, Interpreter Vs Compiler.
6. In Online Test, submission time also matters. So try to submit early if you have
completed all the sections.
If you have any queries, I would be happy to answer them. You can email me at
mohakc10@gmail.com.
